+"""Directed source attraction with a selected-codeword separation barrier."""
+
+import torch
+
+
+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Compute the frozen directed geometry objective.
+
+    Nearest-codeword assignments are discrete and stop-gradient.  Source is the
+    only representation attracted to its selected codeword; target only selects
+    the second endpoint codeword, making the objective explicitly directed.
+    """
+    alpha = float(parameters.get("alpha", 1.0))
+    margin = float(parameters.get("margin", 0.2732))
+    weight = float(parameters.get("lambda", 0.001))
+    valid = mask.to(device=source.device, dtype=torch.bool)
+    if not bool(valid.any()):
+        return (source.sum() + codebook.sum()) * 0.0
+
+    source_valid = source[valid]
+    target_valid = target[valid]
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        a = torch.cdist(source_valid.detach(), codebook.detach()).square().argmin(dim=1)
+        b = torch.cdist(target_valid.detach(), codebook.detach()).square().argmin(dim=1)
+
+    source_codes = codebook[a]
+    target_codes = codebook[b]
+    attraction = (source_valid - source_codes).square().sum(dim=-1)
+    endpoint_distance = torch.linalg.vector_norm(source_codes - target_codes, dim=-1)
+    separation = torch.relu(margin - endpoint_distance).square()
+    return weight * (attraction + alpha * separation).mean()
